new.title: NVIDIA CUDA-X Libraries Give Agents the Tools to Accelerate Scientific Discovery
new.summary: With expanded NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries, including cuPhoton, cuPotential and cuSpa, researchers can sift through vast amounts of data to accelerate research, from astrophysics and materials science to single-cell biology.
